# Skillset

> Skillset is a portable bundle of prompts that runs identically across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, and any LLM. Save prompts once; reuse them in every AI tool. Skill Router automatically picks the cheapest capable model per prompt, cutting LLM spend by 60–80%.

A Skillset for a role is a role-tuned pack of prompts — for example, the Developer Skillset includes code review, debugging, refactoring, and API design prompts; the Marketer Skillset includes ad copy, content calendar, SEO brief, and email sequence prompts. The same Skillset works in your IDE, your browser AI, and your CMS.

## Product

- [Skillsets overview](https://skillset.so/skillsets): Pillar page listing every role-tuned Skillset.
- [Pricing](https://skillset.so/pricing): Free, Pro ($9/mo, 7 custom packs), Studio (17 packs + team marketplace).
- [Downloads](https://skillset.so/downloads): Desktop app for macOS and Windows; Chrome extension; MCP server.
- [Prompts library](https://skillset.so/prompts): Browse free prompt templates by category, platform, or role.

## How Skillset works

- Skillsets are portable bundles of prompts saved as .pmtpk files.
- Free, encrypted, and signed packs are supported.
- Skill Router automatically selects the cheapest capable model (Haiku, Gemini Flash, DeepSeek, GPT-4o, Sonnet, Opus) per prompt based on task complexity.
- Skill Preset locks brand voice, coding conventions, or clinical phrasing across every output.
- The Chrome extension overlays ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and any web text input.
- The desktop app integrates with Cursor, Copilot, JetBrains IDEs, and stores all prompts on-device.
- Skillsets work with BYOK (bring your own key) for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Cohere, AWS Bedrock, Together, Fireworks, and Cerebras.

## Differentiators

- Portable across every major LLM and IDE — unlike custom GPTs (locked to OpenAI) or Claude Projects (locked to Anthropic).
- Local-first: prompts stored on-device for HIPAA-sensitive workflows.
- Token routing: cuts spend 60–80% vs always using a frontier model.
- Marketplace: verified creators sell role-tuned Skillsets and brand-voice packs.
